name: Astral Projection
description: You and up to eight companions project your spirits into the Astral Plane, leaving your bodies sleeping and untouchable by time or hunger, joined to your astral forms by silver cords. From the Astral Sea you can step through colored pools to any other plane, and return by dismissing the spell.

name: Foresight
description: Your touch grants a creature a limited vision of its own immediate future: for 8 hours it cannot be surprised and rolls attacks, ability checks, and saving throws with advantage, while every roll made against it has disadvantage.

name: Gate
description: A shining portal 20 feet across opens between planes, its far side placed with pinpoint precision. Speak the true name of a creature on the far side and the gate drags it through to you — though deities and planar rulers may refuse or forbid the passage in their own domains.

name: Imprisonment
description: You bind a creature in a magical prison of your design — buried in an extradimensional sphere, chained in place, trapped in a gem, or locked in timeless slumber within a demiplane. A Wisdom save resists; otherwise only the special release condition you set, or the mightiest dispelling, can free it.

name: Mass Heal
description: A tide of healing energy restores up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures within range. It also cures blindness, deafness, and diseases afflicting the recipients.

name: Meteor Swarm
description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet from the sky to four points you can see, each exploding in a 40-foot sphere. Creatures in the blast take 20d6 fire damage and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed Dexterity save, or half as much on a success; overlapping spheres strike a creature only once.

name: Power Word Heal
description: A word of restoration that lets a creature spend its reaction to stand and restores it to full hit points. It also lifts the charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned conditions and knocks prone targets back onto their feet.

name: Power Word Kill
description: You speak the word that ends life. A creature you can see with 100 hit points or fewer dies instantly; otherwise, it takes 12d12 psychic damage — no attack roll, no saving throw.

name: Prismatic Wall
description: A shimmering, opaque wall of seven colored layers springs up — up to 90 feet long and 30 feet high, or a globe up to 30 feet across. Its glare forces a Constitution save on any other creature that can see it and moves within 20 feet or starts its turn there; a failure means the Blinded condition for 1 minute. A creature passing through braves every layer in turn, each with its own Dexterity save: red fire, orange acid, yellow lightning, green poison and blue cold (12d6 each, half on a success), indigo restraint that can harden into petrification, and violet blindness that can hurl it to another plane. The layers can be destroyed only one at a time, red to violet, each by its own specific means.

name: Shapechange
description: You assume the form of any creature of challenge rating 20 or lower that you have seen — dragon, fiend, or giant — gaining its statistics while keeping your mind, and you may transform again as an action whenever you like. Wounds carry between forms only when a form is reduced to 0 hit points.

name: Storm of Vengeance
description: A monstrous storm cloud gathers overhead and unleashes escalating wrath round by round: deafening thunder (2d6 thunder damage), acid rain (4d6 acid), arcing lightning (10d6 lightning), pounding hail (2d6 bludgeoning), and finally freezing winds (1d6 cold) that scour everything beneath it. Creatures below make Constitution saves against its first fury or are deafened for minutes.

name: Time Stop
description: Time halts for everyone but you: you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row while the world stands frozen, free to move, prepare, and reposition — until you affect another creature or anything it wears or carries, and the moment shatters.

name: True Polymorph
description: You transform a creature or object utterly — creature into creature, creature into object, or object into creature — on a failed Wisdom save. If you hold the transformation for the full hour it becomes permanent, until dispelled.

name: True Resurrection
description: The mightiest return: a creature dead for up to two centuries is restored to life with full hit points, even if its body was destroyed or its remains are lost — the spell fashions a new body. All curses, diseases, and poisons are cleansed and lost organs regrown.

name: Weird
description: You conjure each victim's deepest nightmare into its mind. Creatures you choose in a 30-foot sphere make a Wisdom save or take 10d10 psychic damage and are frightened (half damage on a success), suffering 5d10 more at the end of each turn until a save frees them.

name: Wish
description: The mightiest spell a mortal can cast: simply speaking reshapes reality. Its safest use duplicates any spell of 8th level or lower without components, but it can also heal a whole company, grant resistances, undo a recent moment, or attempt anything at all — at the risk of warping beyond intent and possibly burning the magic out of you forever. Anything beyond duplicating a spell also stresses you: until you finish a Long Rest, each spell you cast deals you 1d10 necrotic damage per level of that spell, and your Strength score becomes 3 for 2d4 days.
